question: In which year was veteran actor and Bharatanatyam dancer Vyjayanthimala Bali given the Padma Vibhushan award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2024**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Veteran actor and accomplished Bharatanatyam dancer Vyjayanthimala Bali was conferred the **Padma Vibhushan award in 2024**, recognizing her significant contributions to Indian cinema and classical dance.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is India’s second-highest civilian award, given for exceptional and distinguished service across various fields.
 
• Vyjayanthimala is celebrated for her groundbreaking performances in Bollywood and her mastery of the classical dance form Bharatanatyam.
 
• Her career spans decades, with iconic roles in movies like "Madhumati," "Devdas," and "Sangam," earning her critical acclaim and numerous accolades.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan award in 2024 highlights her enduring legacy as a cultural icon in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Awards:**

 
 
• The Padma Awards are among the highest civilian honors in India and are announced annually on Republic Day.
 
• They are divided into three categories: Padma Vibhushan (second-highest), Padma Bhushan (third-highest), and Padma Shri (fourth-highest).
 
• The awards are conferred in disciplines such as art, literature, education, sports, medicine, social work, science, public affairs, and more.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan recognizes "exceptional and distinguished service" in any field.
 
 
 
• **Vyjayanthimala's Contributions:**
 
 
• She is a pioneer in seamlessly blending Bharatanatyam into mainstream cinema, elevating the art form’s prominence.
 
• She has been awarded several honors, including multiple Filmfare Awards for her acting prowess.
 
• Beyond films, her Bharatanatyam performances have been showcased globally, earning her accolades as a cultural ambassador.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam:**
 
 
• Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, originating in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, intricate footwork, hand gestures (mudras), and facial expressions.
 
• The dance form often conveys spiritual themes and stories from Hindu mythology.
 
 
 
• **Bollywood Legacy:**
 
 
• Vyjayanthimala is regarded as one of the first female superstars of Indian cinema.
 
• Her work in films like "Amrapali" showcased her dual talents in acting and classical dance.
 
• She paved the way for actresses to take up roles that combined glamour with substance.
